vote.question: [US-TX - U.S. Senate]: James Talarico (D) has received $146,349,912 in career campaign contributions (with $146,349,912 this cycle, alongside $109,450,197 in outside Super PAC support led by Lone Star Rising PAC)—linked to "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate". Do you vote to formally rebuke James Talarico for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet James Talarico has amassed $146,349,912 in career contributions (with $146,349,912 this cycle, alongside $109,450,197 in outside Super PAC support led by Lone Star Rising PAC)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure James Talarico on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
